meta.generation_rule: Chinese-only projects use one Chinese logic column. Any project containing English or another local language uses Chinese and English programmer-logic columns; respondent wording is generated in one sheet per selected language.
meta.localization_gate: Question IDs, codes, bases, routing, randomization and exclusivity are locked to the Chinese master. Local-language wording requires terminology lock, linguistic review and back-translation before fieldwork.
